about: Big Blue Surf School calls itself Bude's original surf school and has been teaching since 1999. It works from the car park at Summerleaze Beach in Bude, North Cornwall. Since early 2025 it has partnered with OA Surf Club, which adds surfing and coasteering at Widemouth Bay. It teaches complete beginners through to advanced surfers.
where: Summerleaze Beach car park, Bude (EX23 8HJ); Widemouth Bay through the OA Surf Club partnership
goodToKnow: Book online; booking terms and FAQs are on the website
Shows Surfing England accredited surf school status
gaps: No lesson inclusions, what to bring, age limits, cancellation terms or season; only the homepage was read
